notes.general_comments: General Comments This examination paper provided a suitable challenge to the candidates with some very pleasing Twenty one questions can be said to have been found to be easier. 50% or more of candidates chose the correct responses to each of Questions 1, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 9, 10, 12, 14, 17, 18, 22, 24, 27, 29, 30, 31, 34, 37 and 39. Since Questions 37 and 39 are on this list it can be suggested that most candidates found they had sufficient time to complete the paper. Six questions can be said to have been found to be particularly difficult. Less than 35% of candidates chose the correct responses to each of Questions 11, 21, 25, 28, 32, and 35.
